subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses** how technological advancements are progressively influencing medical practices.**
 
• The appropriate word **should denote a slow and steady transition rather than an abrupt or partial change.**
 
• “**Gradually**” aptly describes this** ongoing and continuous shift towards machine usage in healthcare.**
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is **'gradually.'**
 
• Hence the correct statement from the passage is **''****Medical hand practices have been an integral part of healthcare for centuries, but with technological advancements, machines are gradually__ taking over......''**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options (**"sincerely", "partially", "deliberately"**) **do not accurately convey** the idea of a slow and steady change.

 
• **Sincerely** (ईमानदारी से): Typically used to express honesty or genuineness,** not fitting the contex**t of describing how technology is replacing traditional methods.
 
• **Partially** (आंशिक रूप से): Indicates an incomplete or limited transition,** which does not fully capture** the ongoing process of technological integration in medical practices.
 
• **Deliberately** (जानबूझकर): Suggests intentionality, which** does not appropriately describe **the natural progression mentioned in the passage.
